objective: Make the privileged kernel fault-suite result explicit and prevent skipped execution from passing CI.
acceptance: the runtime fault result is exactly PASS, NOT_EXECUTED, or FAIL
module insertion and fault-suite outcomes appear in the job summary
only an executed and successful fault suite satisfies the kernel CI gate
a regression test prevents skipped runtime verification from appearing green
stop_conditions: the hosted runner cannot execute privileged kernel module tests
firmware or interface changes are required
a release gate outside the repository must be changed
